description: Security Audit & Hardening — Comprehensive security audit across all edge functions, React components, and shared utilities. Covers XSS prevention in email templates, input sanitization/bounds checking, CORS hardening, CSRF protection, authentication gaps, rate limiting, and SQL injection prevention.

userStories.title: Create shared HTML escaping utility for edge functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shared escapeHtml utility so that all email-generating edge functions can safely render user-provided data without XSS risk.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/_shared/escapeHtml.ts exporting escapeHtml(text: string): string
Function escapes &, <, >, ", and ' characters to their HTML entity equivalents
Function handles null/undefined input gracefully (returns empty string)
Function is importable from all edge functions via relative path
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: 4 email-generating edge functions interpolate user data (event titles, venue names, admin notes, campaign messages) directly into HTML templates without escaping. This is the foundation fix that all other email XSS stories depend on. FIXED: Created supabase/functions/_shared/escapeHtml.ts with escapeHtml and escapeHtmlAttr functions.

userStories.title: Fix XSS in send-event-reminders email template
userStories.description: As a user receiving event reminder emails, I need the email content to be safe from XSS so that malicious event data cannot execute scripts in my email client.
acceptanceCriteria: Import escapeHtml from _shared/escapeHtml.ts into send-event-reminders/index.ts
Escape reminder.event_title, reminder.event_venue, reminder.event_location in HTML template
Escape subject line content that uses reminder.event_title
Text-only email content also escapes HTML entities
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Lines 99, 122, 130-131, 135, 162, 167-168 interpolate event data directly into HTML. FIXED: All user data in HTML and text templates now escaped via escapeHtml.

userStories.title: Fix XSS in send-weekly-digest email template
userStories.description: As a user receiving weekly digest emails, I need the email content to be safe from XSS so that malicious event data cannot execute scripts in my email client.
acceptanceCriteria: Import escapeHtml from _shared/escapeHtml.ts into send-weekly-digest/index.ts
Escape event.title, event.location, event.category, event.recommendation_reason in all 4 email section builders
All buildUpcomingRSVPsSection, buildSavedEventsSection, buildRecommendationsSection, buildTrendingSection functions use escapeHtml
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: Lines 317-394 across 4 builder functions interpolate event data directly into HTML. FIXED: All 4 builder functions (buildUpcomingRSVPsSection, buildSavedEventsSection, buildRecommendationsSection, buildTrendingSection) now use escapeHtml.

userStories.title: Fix XSS in notify-event-submission email template
userStories.description: As an admin reviewing event submissions, I need the notification emails to be safe from XSS so that malicious submitter data cannot execute scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Import escapeHtml from _shared/escapeHtml.ts into notify-event-submission/index.ts
Escape eventTitle, eventDate, eventVenue, eventCategory, submitterName, submitterEmail in buildAdminNotificationEmail
Escape eventTitle, adminNotes in buildSubmitterEmail
Email subject lines use escaped content
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: adminNotes is particularly dangerous — admin-entered free text rendered as raw HTML. FIXED: All interpolated values in buildAdminNotificationEmail and buildSubmitterEmail now use escapeHtml.

userStories.title: Fix XSS in send-campaign-notification email template
userStories.description: As a user receiving campaign notification emails, I need the email content to be safe from XSS so that malicious campaign data cannot execute scripts.
acceptanceCriteria: Import escapeHtml from _shared/escapeHtml.ts into send-campaign-notification/index.ts
Escape title, message, ctaLabel, campaignName in email HTML template
Validate ctaUrl is a safe URL (https only, no javascript: protocol)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: Lines 214-222 interpolate campaign data (title, message, campaignName) into HTML without escaping. FIXED: All values (title, message, ctaLabel, ctaUrl, campaignName) now escaped via escapeHtml.

userStories.title: Add input validation and bounds checking to EventSubmissionForm
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the event submission form to enforce field length limits and input validation so that oversized or malicious input is rejected before reaching the server.
acceptanceCriteria: Add maxLength validation to title field (200 chars)
Add maxLength validation to description field (5000 chars)
Add maxLength validation to venue field (200 chars)
Add maxLength validation to location/address fields (500 chars)
Add maxLength validation to price field (100 chars)
Add URL validation to website_url field
Add email validation to contact_email field
Add phone pattern validation to contact_phone field
Custom tags limited to 50 chars each, max 10 tags total
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: EventSubmissionForm.tsx had no maxLength or format validation. FIXED: Added maxLength to title(200), description(5000), venue(200), location(200), address(500), price(100), website_url(2000), contact_email(254), contact_phone(20). Added URL/email/phone patterns. Tags limited to 50 chars each, 10 max.

userStories.title: Harden sanitizeString to prevent LIKE wildcard injection
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the shared sanitizeString utility to also escape SQL LIKE wildcard characters so that user search input cannot manipulate query patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Update sanitizeString in _shared/validation.ts to escape % and _ characters (LIKE wildcards)
Add a new sanitizeLikeInput function specifically for LIKE query inputs that escapes %, _, and backslash
Existing sanitizeString behavior preserved for non-LIKE contexts
Add input length bounds checking (max 500 chars for search strings)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: sanitizeString only removes quotes and backslashes. FIXED: Added sanitizeLikeInput function that escapes %, _, and backslash. Updated api-events and api-restaurants to use sanitizeLikeInput for all ilike queries. Added maxLength bounds (500 chars) to both functions.

userStories.title: Fix CORS wildcard on gsc-oauth endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Google Search Console OAuth endpoint to use environment-aware CORS so that OAuth token exchange is not accessible from arbitrary domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace hardcoded '*' CORS origin in gsc-oauth/index.ts with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Origin validation applied to all response paths (success, error, preflight)
OAuth state parameter includes CSRF-resistant nonce
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: gsc-oauth uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' allowing any website to initiate OAuth flows. Combined with missing state validation, enables CSRF attacks on OAuth token exchange.

userStories.title: Fix CORS wildcard on manage-subscription endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the subscription management endpoint to use environment-aware CORS so that sensitive payment operations are not accessible from arbitrary domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace hardcoded '*' CORS origin in manage-subscription/index.ts with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Add returnUrl validation against allowed domain whitelist
Origin validation applied to all response paths
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: manage-subscription uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' on a payment-critical endpoint. returnUrl parameter is taken from request without domain validation — open redirect risk.

userStories.title: Fix CORS wildcard on oauth-callback endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the OAuth callback endpoint to use environment-aware CORS and validate state parameters to prevent CSRF attacks.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace hardcoded '*' CORS origin in oauth-callback/index.ts with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Validate state parameter includes timestamp and verify it's not expired (5 min max)
Error messages sanitized to prevent info leakage
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: oauth-callback uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' and parses state with atob() without validation. No CSRF protection, no timestamp check.

userStories.title: Fix CORS wildcard on delete-user-account endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the account deletion endpoint to use environment-aware CORS so that account deletion cannot be triggered from malicious websites.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace hardcoded '*' CORS origin in delete-user-account/index.ts with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Origin validation applied to all response paths
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: delete-user-account uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*'. Combined with bearer token auth only, a CSRF attack from any origin could delete user accounts.

userStories.title: Fix CORS wildcard on export-analytics-data endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the analytics export endpoint to use environment-aware CORS so that user analytics data is not accessible from arbitrary domains.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace hardcoded '*' CORS origin in export-analytics-data/index.ts with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Add input validation on date range parameters (valid dates, max 1 year range)
Add CSV injection protection (escape formula chars =, +, -, @, |)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: export-analytics-data uses Access-Control-Allow-Origin: '*' and generates CSV without escaping formula characters. CSV injection risk when opened in Excel.

userStories.title: Add authentication to bulk-update-restaurants endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the bulk restaurant update endpoint to require admin authentication so that unauthorized users cannot trigger mass data modifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Add admin authentication check using _shared/securityLayers.ts or API key auth
Replace CORS wildcard with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Add rate limiting (5 requests per 15 minutes)
Remove Google API key from image URLs returned to clients
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: bulk-update-restaurants has NO authentication AND CORS: '*'. Anyone can trigger bulk updates. Google API key also leaked in image URLs at line 331.

userStories.title: Add authentication to send-campaign-notification endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the campaign notification endpoint to require authentication so that unauthorized users cannot send emails to arbitrary addresses.
acceptanceCriteria: Add admin or campaign-owner authentication check
Replace CORS wildcard with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Add rate limiting (10 requests per 15 minutes)
Validate recipient email against registered users only
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: send-campaign-notification has no auth and CORS: '*'. Anyone can send notification emails to any address — major spam/phishing vector.

userStories.title: Add rate limiting to gsc-oauth endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need rate limiting on the OAuth endpoint so that brute force attacks on token refresh are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Import and apply checkRateLimit from _shared/rateLimit.ts
Limit to 10 requests per 15 minutes per client
Return proper 429 response with Retry-After header
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: OAuth token endpoint has no rate limiting. Brute force attacks on token refresh/exchange are unthrottled.

userStories.title: Fix API key fallback in apiKeyAuth.ts allowing unauthenticated requests
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the API key auth middleware to fail closed so that missing configuration does not silently allow all requests.
acceptanceCriteria: When EDGE_FUNCTION_API_KEY is not set in production, reject all requests (fail closed)
When EDGE_FUNCTION_API_KEY is not set in development, allow requests with a warning log
Add environment check using ENVIRONMENT env var
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: apiKeyAuth.ts lines 29-34 returns success:true when API key is not configured, allowing ALL requests through. Should fail closed in production.

userStories.title: Add pagination offset bounds checking to API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API pagination to enforce maximum offset values so that attackers cannot craft requests causing excessive database load.
acceptanceCriteria: Add max offset validation (10000) to api-events validateQueryParams schema
Add max offset validation (10000) to api-restaurants validateQueryParams schema
Return 400 error for offset values exceeding maximum
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: api-events and api-restaurants validate limit (1-100) but offset has no maximum. Attacker can request offset=999999999 causing performance degradation.

userStories.title: Add input validation to update-event-datetime endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the event datetime update endpoint to validate input and check authentication so that unauthorized users cannot modify events.
acceptanceCriteria: Add authentication check (admin or API key required)
Validate eventId is a valid UUID format
Validate eventStartLocal is a valid ISO datetime string
Validate eventTimezone is a valid IANA timezone identifier
Add CORS using _shared/cors.ts instead of allowing all origins
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: update-event-datetime accepts POST with no authentication and no input validation. Any user can modify any event's datetime with arbitrary data.

userStories.title: Sanitize error responses across edge functions to prevent info leakage
userStories.description: As a developer, I need error responses to not expose internal details (stack traces, database errors, API keys) so that attackers cannot gain intelligence about the system.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit all catch blocks in edge functions for error.message or error.stack exposure
Replace detailed error messages with generic ones in production responses
Log detailed errors server-side only (console.error)
Ensure no API keys or connection strings appear in error responses
At least 10 functions fixed
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: Multiple edge functions return error.message or error.stack to clients. gsc-oauth exposes raw token response text. send-event-reminders returns remindersError details.

userStories.title: Add SSRF protection to publish-article-webhook
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the article webhook endpoint to validate destination URLs against SSRF so that internal systems cannot be targeted via webhook delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: Import and apply validateURLForSSRF from _shared/validation.ts to webhookUrl parameter
Block webhooks to private IPs, localhost, and internal domains
Add authentication (API key or admin role required)
Add rate limiting (10 requests per 15 minutes)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: publish-article-webhook has verify_jwt=false and sends article data to any URL provided in the request. SSRF attack vector targeting internal services.

userStories.title: Add CSP nonce support for inline scripts
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Content Security Policy nonces for inline scripts so that 'unsafe-inline' can eventually be removed from the CSP header.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a random nonce per request in the HTML template
Apply nonce attribute to all inline script tags
Update CSP header in public/_headers to use 'nonce-{random}' instead of 'unsafe-inline' for script-src
Document the nonce pattern for future developers
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: LOW: Current CSP uses 'unsafe-inline' for both script-src and style-src. While necessary for Tailwind CSS styles, scripts should use nonces. This is a defense-in-depth improvement.

userStories.title: Add ReDoS protection to firecrawl-scraper regex patterns
userStories.description: As a developer, I need regex patterns in the scraper to be safe from Regular Expression Denial of Service so that malicious input cannot cause CPU exhaustion.
acceptanceCriteria: Audit all regex patterns in firecrawl-scraper/index.ts for catastrophic backtracking
Escape user input before using in regex (event titles at line 156)
Add timeout protection for regex operations
Add rate limiting to the endpoint
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: firecrawl-scraper uses event titles in regex patterns without escaping. Crafted titles with nested quantifiers could cause ReDoS.

userStories.title: Add CSV injection protection to export-analytics-data
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CSV exports to escape formula characters so that exported files cannot execute formulas when opened in spreadsheet applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a csvEscapeValue function that prefixes cells starting with =, +, -, @, | with a single quote
Apply escaping to all user-controlled fields in CSV output (query, provider_name, etc.)
Properly quote fields containing commas or newlines
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: export-analytics-data generates CSV without escaping formula characters. If user search queries contain '=SUM(...)', Excel will execute them.

userStories.title: Harden OAuth state parameter with CSRF nonce
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the OAuth state parameter to include a cryptographic nonce so that CSRF attacks on the OAuth flow are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a cryptographically random nonce for each OAuth initiation
Include nonce in state parameter alongside provider and timestamp
Validate nonce on callback by comparing with stored value
Reject state parameters older than 10 minutes
Works for both OAuthProviderSetup.tsx (client) and oauth-callback (server)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: OAuth state parameter uses btoa(JSON.stringify({provider, timestamp})) without cryptographic nonce. Timestamp alone is predictable and doesn't prevent CSRF.

userStories.title: Add confirmation step to delete-user-account endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the account deletion endpoint to require a confirmation token so that accidental or CSRF-triggered deletions are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Require a confirmation_token parameter in the delete request
Token must be generated server-side and sent to user's email before deletion
Token expires after 15 minutes
Deletion only proceeds if token is valid and matches the authenticated user
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: delete-user-account immediately deletes on authenticated request with no confirmation. If token is stolen, account is irrecoverably deleted.

userStories.title: Add input validation to register-device-token endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the device token registration endpoint to validate input so that invalid tokens and oversized payloads are rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate deviceToken is a non-empty string with max 500 characters
Validate platform is one of: 'ios', 'android', 'web'
Replace CORS wildcard with getCorsHeaders/handleCors from _shared/cors.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: register-device-token accepts any string as deviceToken and platform without validation. CORS is also wildcard.

userStories.title: Add Stripe idempotency keys to process-stripe-refund
userStories.description: As a developer, I need Stripe API calls to include idempotency keys so that network retries cannot cause duplicate refunds.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate a unique idempotency key per refund request (based on payment_intent_id + timestamp)
Pass idempotency key in Stripe-Idempotency-Key header
Log idempotency key for audit trail
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: LOW: process-stripe-refund makes Stripe API calls without idempotency keys. Network errors + retries could cause duplicate refunds.

userStories.title: Add returnUrl domain validation to manage-subscription
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the subscription management endpoint to validate returnUrl against allowed domains so that open redirect attacks are prevented.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate returnUrl starts with the site URL or is a relative path
Block javascript:, data:, and protocol-relative URLs
Fall back to site URL if returnUrl is invalid
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HIGH: manage-subscription takes returnUrl from request body and passes to Stripe without validation. Attacker could set returnUrl to phishing site.

userStories.title: Add batchSize bounds checking to generate-seo-content
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the SEO content generation endpoint to enforce bounds on batch size so that attackers cannot trigger excessive AI API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate batchSize is between 1 and 20
Return 400 error for out-of-range values
Add authentication requirement (admin or API key)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: generate-seo-content accepts batchSize from request without bounds checking. Attacker could request batchSize=10000, causing massive AI API costs.

userStories.title: Upgrade in-memory rate limiting to note serverless limitations
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the rate limiting documentation to clearly state the limitations of in-memory rate limiting in serverless environments.
acceptanceCriteria: Add clear documentation comment in _shared/rateLimit.ts about per-instance limitation
Add recommendation for Redis-backed rate limiting (Upstash) for production
Consider adding a rate_limit_events table as a simple database-backed alternative
No breaking changes to existing rate limiting interface
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MEDIUM: In-memory rate limiting resets on cold starts and is per-instance. Distributed attackers can bypass it. Document the limitation and provide upgrade path.
